8799553ada353a8d.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مجمع علاج الرياض الطبي عن أخصائي مختبرات طبية للانضمام إلى فريقه في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور على ضمان سير العمليات المخبرية بكفاءة ودقة، بدءًا من توفير المواد اللازمة وحتى إعداد التقارير الطبية. وهو دور بدوام كامل يتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تحديد احتياجات المختبر من المواد الطبية اللازمة للفحوصات، وتوفيرها، وتسجيلها، والتأكد من سلامتها وتعقيمها، ومراقبة فترة صلاحيتها. استلام عينات الفحص من المرضى وحفظها بالطرق السليمة، وإجراء التحاليل الكيميائية والفيزيائية والمجهرية اللازمة لتحديد وجود السكر أو البروتين أو الجراثيم والطفيليات. دراسة نتائج الاختبارات المخبرية وإعداد التقارير المفصلة بشأنها. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل المخبري ومواكبة التطورات الحديثة في أساليب التحاليل الطبية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير الطبية المتعلقة بالتحاليل الطبية للمرضى وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها، بما يتوافق مع السياسات والإجراءات المنظمة. ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة بشكل صارم أثناء القيام بمختلف أعمال المختبرات الطبية. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المختبرات الطبية. القدرة على تحديد احتياجات المختبر من المواد الأولية وإدارتها. مهارات ممتازة في إجراء التحاليل والفحوصات المخبرية بدقة. القدرة على إعداد الوثائق والتقارير الطبية وحفظها. بيئة العمل يعمل أخصائي المختبرات الطبية ضمن فريق مجمع علاج الرياض الطبي في مدينة الرياض. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والجودة العالية في بيئة عمل مخبرية. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية التوظيف.

87336cb1ff38c265.description: Job description Job description: Operations & Maintenance Technician / Engineer Job purpose: The Operations & Maintenance Technician / Engineer is responsible for the safe, reliable, and efficient operation and maintenance of Envac pneumatic waste collection systems. The role supports planned preventive maintenance, corrective repairs, troubleshooting, inspections, system monitoring, spare-parts control, and customer/site support to maintain high system availability. Key Responsibilities Operate and monitor Envac pneumatic waste collection systems, including collection stations, inlet stations, pneumatic equipment, electrical controls, and associated mechanical components. Perform routine, preventive, and proactive maintenance in accordance with approved maintenance schedules, technical manuals, and site-specific procedures. Envac documentation emphasizes routine, preventive, and proactive maintenance as core operational requirements. Diagnose and rectify mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, and control-system faults; respond to breakdowns promptly to minimize downtime. Conduct regular inspections, functional testing, and condition assessments; identify defects and ensure repairs are completed within required timeframes. Carry out authorized electrical and pneumatic work, commissioning support, and initial start-up activities in accordance with Envac procedures. Maintain accurate service records, inspection reports, maintenance checklists, fault reports, and technical documentation. Use computerized maintenance and control systems to track work orders, equipment performance, maintenance history, and service activities. Monitor and maintain appropriate stock levels of critical spare parts, consumables, tools, and materials. Support scheduled replacement of worn or failed components and recommend improvements to maintenance plans, equipment reliability, and system performance. Ensure all work is performed in compliance with Envac requirements, site procedures, applicable legislation, and HSE standards. Apply safe isolation procedures before maintenance, including isolation of electrical power and compressed air, lockout/tagout, and use of appropriate PPE. Documentation requires compressed air to be turned off before work on pneumatically operated equipment and safety switches isolated before electrical work. Coordinate professionally with clients, facilities-management teams, subcontractors, and internal operations teams; provide technical guidance and site updates where required. Participate in shift work, on-call duty, emergency call-outs, and weekend/public-holiday coverage as required by the site operation. Envac is seeking a safety-focused and technically capable Operations & Maintenance Technician / Engineer to support the reliable operation of advanced pneumatic waste collection systems. The successful candidate will combine hands-on electro-mechanical maintenance capability with strong troubleshooting skills, disciplined documentation, and a commitment to excellent customer service and continuous improvement. Skills Skills Required Qualifications and Experience Diploma or bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Alternatively, a recognized technical/vocational qualification with relevant hands-on operations and maintenance experience. Typically 2–5 years of experience in maintenance, facilities operations, industrial automation, pneumatic conveying, waste-management systems, utilities, or comparable electro-mechanical systems. Hands-on experience in fault-finding and maintenance of mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, and control equipment. Experience with PLC-controlled systems, sensors, actuators, motors, fans, compressors, valves, VFDs, and industrial electrical panels is strongly preferred. Familiarity with computerized maintenance management systems (CMMS), work-order management, and technical reporting. Valid driving licence is preferred, subject to site and local requirements. Required Technical Skills Strong practical knowledge of mechanical, electrical, and pneumatic systems. Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, electrical schematics, P&IDs, manuals, equipment layouts, and maintenance procedures. Competence in systematic troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and corrective-action follow-up. Ability to perform inspections, servicing, adjustment, replacement, and functional testing of equipment. Understanding of preventive and condition-based maintenance practices. Knowledge of spare-parts identification, inventory control, and maintenance planning. Basic computer skills, including MS Office and maintenance/reporting systems. Knowledge of safe work practices, permit-to-work systems, lockout/tagout, and risk assessment. Required Personal Skills Strong safety mindset, attention to detail, and ability to follow procedures consistently. Proactive, dependable, and able to work independently while collaborating effectively with a team. Calm and methodical approach to breakdown response and time-critical troubleshooting. Good communication skills in English; Arabic is an advantage for Qatar-based roles. Customer-focused approach with professional site conduct. Physically capable of working in industrial environments, including exposure to noise, moving equipment, confined or restricted spaces, and outdoor conditions, subject to medical fitness requirements. Willingness to undertake Envac-specific technical and safety training. Envac component guidance specifies that maintenance procedures must be completed by trained personnel or personnel with solid experience handling the relevant components. Preferred Certifications Electrical authorization or electrical safety certification. NEBOSH, IOSH, OSHA, or equivalent HSE certification. First Aid and Fire Safety training. Confined Space Entry, Working at Height, LOTO, and Permit-to-Work training. PLC, industrial automation, pneumatic systems, or mechanical maintenance certifications.

870c781f1a6f3a0d.description: About UE Systems UE Systems provides ultrasound solutions designed to enhance the efficiency, reliability, and safety of facility operations. Since 1973, the company has supported customers globally in preventing equipment failures, identifying energy losses, and ensuring operational safety. UE Systems is expanding its global operating system to support continued growth. The Role of Calibration Technician UE Systems is seeking a Calibration Technician to join its service operations in Dammam, Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves calibrating, troubleshooting, repairing, and testing precision ultrasonic instrumentation. The technician will ensure all products meet UE Systems' quality standards before being returned to customers, directly supporting the company's commitment to reliable products and customer service across the Middle East. This position requires a certified technician who is detail-oriented, proactive, organized, and self-motivated. The successful candidate will manage their workload independently, prioritize demands, and ensure efficient completion of repairs and calibrations while adhering to quality and service turnaround expectations. Initial employment will include approximately two weeks of hands-on technical training at UE Systems' headquarters in the Netherlands, covering products, calibration procedures, repair techniques, quality standards, and service processes. Key Responsibilities Perform calibration, troubleshooting, testing, and repair of UE Systems' precision ultrasonic instrumentation. Diagnose faults in analogue and digital printed circuit boards, electronic components, and electro-mechanical assemblies. Execute soldering, component replacement, and mechanical assembly/disassembly as required. Operate electronic test equipment, including oscilloscopes, digital multimeters, power supplies, and signal generators, to diagnose and verify equipment performance. Complete calibrations and repairs in accordance with UE Systems' quality standards, technical procedures, and service documentation. Generate and maintain accurate calibration certificates, repair records, and other service documentation. Manage assigned repairs and calibrations independently while consistently meeting established quality and service turnaround expectations. Coordinate the shipping, receiving, and tracking of customer equipment and repair parts for domestic and international shipments. Maintain inventory of repair parts, calibration equipment, tools, and service consumables. Ensure the service area, tools, and equipment are maintained in a clean, organized, and safe condition. Communicate professionally with customers and internal teams regarding repair status, service updates, and technical questions. Represent UE Systems professionally by delivering technical service and customer support throughout the Middle East. Follow all company quality, safety, and operational procedures. Candidate Requirements Saudi National. 2-5 years of experience in a relevant technical role. Certified technician with a background in hands-on technical work. Demonstrated ability to deliver accurate, high-quality results. Strong problem-solving, time management, and organizational skills. Ability to work independently with minimal supervision. Commitment to providing exceptional customer service. Work Environment and Company Culture This role is based in UE Systems' newly established office in Dammam, Saudi Arabia. Required Skills: Strong experience in infrastructure project planning and scheduling. Expertise in Primavera P6/P3 and project control methodologies. Excellent analytical, reporting, and communication skills. Ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary project teams and manage multiple project schedules simultaneously. 876f3ec059deb90b.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ارتكاز الحديث عن مهندس مدني للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تنفيذ المشاريع الإنشائية وضمان توافقها مع المواصفات الفنية والجداول الزمنية المعتمدة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة، مما يجعله فرصة مثالية للمهندسين المدنيين في بداية مسيرتهم المهنية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تنفيذ المشاريع الإنشائية للشركة وفقًا للمواصفات الفنية والجدول الزمني المعتمد. توثيق جميع المعلومات الفنية والتقارير، والتحقق من دقة المستندات والبيانات. مراجعة ومتابعة تقدم المشروع وفقًا لسير العمل المحدد، وتقديم تقارير دورية إلى مدير الإدارة. التنسيق المستمر مع إدارة المواد والمشتريات لضمان توفر المواد الخام اللازمة للعمل. التنسيق مع المقاولين والعميل النهائي أثناء تنفيذ المشروع لتجاوز أي عقبات وتسريع العمل. تحديد المخاطر وتطبيق إجراءات السلامة والصحة المهنية في جميع مراحل المشروع. ضمان التنفيذ السليم للأعمال الإنشائية وفقًا للمعايير الهندسية المحلية وأنظمة سلامة البناء المعترف بها عالميًا. إعداد تقارير دورية عن أنشطة الإدارة والمشروع. تقديم الدعم اللازم للمدير المباشر وتنفيذ أي مهام أخرى يتم التكليف بها ضمن مجال الخبرة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال الهندسة المدنية. القدرة على تنفيذ السياسات والإجراءات الخاصة بالإدارة والمشاريع. فهم جيد للمواصفات الفنية والجداول الزمنية للمشاريع الإنشائية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في التوثيق وإعداد التقارير الفنية. القدرة على المتابعة والتنسيق الفعال مع الأطراف المختلفة. معرفة قوية بإجراءات السلامة والصحة المهنية. الالتزام بالمعايير الهندسية وأنظمة سلامة البناء. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في الموقع لتنفيذ ومتابعة المشاريع الإنشائية. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق شركة ارتكاز الحديث، يرجى التقديم لهذه الفرصة في الرياض. سيتم مناقشة تفاصيل الراتب خلال المقابلة.

87852dd6fdac00fc.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ابار واولاده الغذائية عن مراقب كاميرات أمنية للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على الإشراف على عمليات كاميرات المراقبة الأمنية، وتشغيل أنظمة المراقبة، والتعامل مع حالات الطوارئ الأمنية والاستجابة لها على مدار الساعة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية الإشراف على عمليات كاميرات المراقبة الأمنية، والتعامل مع حالات الإنذار وطوارئ الحرائق والتحقيق فيها، وضمان الاستجابة الفورية لهذه الحالات على مدار الساعة. تشغيل أنظمة الإنذار وكاميرات المراقبة ومراقبتها وصيانتها بشكل دوري. تنزيل التسجيلات وإدارتها لاستخدامها في التحقيقات المستقبلية، مع ضمان الامتثال التام لقواعد ولوائح خصوصية البيانات. التحقيق في الحالات الطارئة وانتهاكات السياسات والإجراءات الأمنية المعتمدة. اتباع السياسات والإجراءات التي تتوافق مع القوانين واللوائح الأمنية المعمول بها، وإبلاغ الإدارة بالمشكلات عند حدوثها. رفع التقارير المتعلقة بالأسباب والنتائج للإدارة، وتقديم التوصيات اللازمة لمسار العمل. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال مراقبة الكاميرات الأمنية أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على العمل بفعالية ضمن فريق وفي بيئة تتطلب اليقظة المستمرة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب التواجد في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. يتطلب العمل الاستجابة لحالات الطوارئ الأمنية على مدار الساعة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة. التقديم إذا كنت تستوفي المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه ولديك الشغف بالعمل في مجال الأمن، ندعوك للتقديم على هذا الدور.

87a1a2c0bcf00502.description: About the Role Tahaluf is seeking a Sales Manager LIONS to oversee assigned territories and contribute to achieving and exceeding sales revenue targets. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. The Sales Manager will identify, develop, and convert commercial opportunities across various sectors, including brands, agencies, media companies, technology platforms, and the wider creative economy. Key Focus Areas Achieve sales revenue targets, manage campaigns, and oversee floor plans within established timelines. Meet KPIs related to phone time, face-to-face meetings, and system usage. Ensure high exhibitor satisfaction through regular follow-ups, onsite rebookings, and retention efforts. Provide timely and accurate reporting of sales results, pipeline, and activities. Develop new business with priority brands, agencies, media, technology, and creative-industry clients. Grow existing accounts by fostering deeper relationships and identifying relevant commercial opportunities. Communicate the LIONS proposition, audience, and Festival experience effectively. Contribute to a high-quality commercial mix that enhances the overall Festival. Responsibilities Identify, pitch, and secure participation from relevant brands, agencies, media companies, technology platforms, production businesses, and creative organizations for the Festival. Drive sales performance in assigned product areas to achieve individual revenue targets. Understand client objectives and support their achievement through event campaigns, tailoring sales approaches to build and enhance relationships. Maintain regular contact with existing clients throughout the event cycle and manage accounts onsite to ensure high satisfaction and retention. Build strong relationships with multiple client stakeholders. Identify new prospects using industry media, social media, online resources, networking, and the company CRM. Develop new business and revenue streams, including sponsorship and other non-square-meter opportunities. Collaborate with Commercial, Marketing, and Creative teams to develop tailored client solutions. Present and sell commercial opportunities through value-led pitches. Monitor debt reports and assist the finance team with revenue collection. Continuously research the market, gather customer feedback, attend competitor events, and network within the industry. Provide up-to-date market intelligence to the Head of Sales and Marketing Manager for campaign support. Stay informed on industry trends, major agencies, brands, media platforms, and emerging creative businesses relevant to LIONS Riyadh. Support onsite account management to ensure clients receive the commercial experience promised during the sales process. Qualifications and Requirements Minimum of 3 years of experience as a Sales Manager. Relevant commercial experience may be considered in place of formal qualifications. Confidence in engaging with senior client stakeholders and decision-makers. Strong CRM discipline and ability to manage an active sales pipeline. Collaborative approach and ability to work closely with Marketing, Content, Creative, and Operations teams. Existing relationships across brands, agencies, media, or technology companies. Awareness of exhibition production. Saudi Arabia or GCC market experience. Experience selling bespoke or solutions-led commercial products. Strong interest in creativity, culture, media, and emerging industry trends.

87ea12225e63afba.description: About the Role moomoo is seeking an experienced and data-driven Customer Service Manager to build, lead, and motivate a team of Customer Success Specialists. The manager will be responsible for ensuring the team delivers exceptional service, drives key business outcomes in customer retention, expansion, and satisfaction, and acts as a strategist, process optimizer, and cross-functional collaborator. Key Responsibilities Lead and manage a team of customer service representatives, providing direction, mentorship, and performance management. Foster a positive and collaborative team environment to achieve high levels of customer satisfaction and enhance team effectiveness. Oversee escalated customer inquiries and complaints, ensuring timely and effective resolution. Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with clients to understand their needs and concerns. Analyze client feedback and implement strategies to drive improvements in customer satisfaction. Analyze client interaction data and feedback to proactively identify potential opportunities for upsell, cross-sell, or product expansion, leading the team to drive these conversions. Identify and implement process improvements within the customer service department. Develop and enforce best practices to streamline workflows and enhance operational efficiency. 87f023f9467edf5f.description: About the Role Virtucruit is collaborating with a prominent mining company in Saudi Arabia to recruit a Storekeeper for their Logistics Department. 87487083766e1e59.description: About the Company: At Almosafer Travel & Tourism Co, we’re not just part of the travel industry, we’re helping shape its future. As Saudi Arabia’s leading travel company, we serve millions across every segment of the travel and tourism ecosystem. Rooted in our name “Almosafer,” meaning the traveler, we strive to make every journey seamless, personal, and purposeful. Our diverse platforms and services are built to deliver enriching experiences that reflect the spirit of Saudi Arabia and the wider region. We’re united by a bold vision: To be the undisputed leader in travel services, fostering lasting connections and setting new benchmarks for excellence in the Kingdom and beyond. Our team across Saudi Arabia and the wider region blends deep cultural understanding with forward-thinking innovation, shaping a new standard for travel in the region. About the Role: We're looking for a Specialist Arabic copywriter who owns the words behind our brands. You'll write for every touchpoint, from social posts and CRM journeys to in-app UX copy and travel packages. You'll be the final word on quality, so every piece goes out on-brand, culturally sharp and built to convert. Responsibilities: Write original, compelling Arabic copy across websites, apps, newsletters, brochures, social media and paid campaigns. Develop travel packages, itineraries, and promotional materials that inspire and convert. Write CRM content (email, push, SMS, in-app) tailored to the relevant audience segments and lifecycle stages. Create UX/UI content, including microcopy, onboarding flows, error states, CTAs and product screens, in close collaboration with product and design teams. Use AI tools to speed up ideation, drafting and versioning. Test and refine AI-generated content so it meets brand, cultural and quality standards. Plan and run copy A/B tests across digital channels, and use performance data to improve messaging. Act as the final approval point for Arabic content, reviewing and signing off work from internal writers, agencies and freelancers. Keep brand voice and tone consistent across all platforms for both Discover Saudi and Mawasim. Write clear, concise copy for infographics, flyers and other brand collateral. Act as a key point of contact across departments (marketing, product, CRM, business and creative teams), turning briefs into effective messaging and communicating clearly in both Arabic and English. Profile requirements: Bachelor's degree in Journalism, Media, Communications, Arabic Literature or a related field. At least 5 years of copywriting experience, ideally in a creative or digital agency or another fast-paced environment. Proven experience writing for digital marketing: social media, CRM, paid and owned channels. Hands-on experience with AI content tools, plus a clear process for testing and quality-checking their output. Familiarity with UX writing principles and content design for digital products. Proven track record as the final approver or senior sign-off on content. Excellent writing, editing and proofreading skills in Arabic, with strong attention to detail and cultural nuance. Fluent in spoken and written English, with the confidence to present ideas, take briefs and give feedback across departments and stakeholders. Deep understanding of Saudi culture and of dialects across the regions. Working knowledge of CMS, SEM, CRM and social media platforms. Creative and strategic thinking, with a portfolio of successful campaigns. Excellent organization and time management, with the ability to handle several projects at once. Flexibility to accommodate occasional urgent requests outside standard working hours during peak periods, such as the summer season and major campaigns. Strong sense of ownership and accountability, with the ability to manage projects from brief to launch. Ability to thrive under pressure, manage tight deadlines and deliver high-quality work within short turnaround times. Being you @ Almosafer: At Almosafer, our teams work with purpose, clarity, and a shared commitment to doing things the right way. Whether you're building platforms, supporting travelers, or shaping strategy, your work connects to something bigger. Across functions and locations, we value accountability, trust, and collaboration - and we create the structure and space for you to contribute meaningfully from day one. Here, you will find: A purpose-led workplace where your ideas can create real impact Ongoing learning and development to help you grow with intention Recognition that celebrates your wins, both big and small A community built on trust, curiosity, and shared momentum No matter where your journey started, at Almosafer, you will find space to grow, connect, and contribute meaningfully.

Partner with department heads to understand manpower requirements, budget considerations, and succession planning needs. 87d7e98251fee45d.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مركز الباندا لحضانة الأطفال عن حارس أمن للانضمام إلى فريقه في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى ضمان أمن وسلامة الأطفال والممتلكات، بالإضافة إلى تنظيم حركة الدخول والخروج من المنشأة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مراقبة عمليات دخول وخروج الأطفال والأهالي من وإلى المنشأة، وإصدار التصاريح اللازمة. التحقق من هوية أولياء الأمور والزوار وتسجيل بياناتهم لضمان الأمن. الوقوف عند بوابة المركز صباحًا ومساءً لتنظيم حركة سير السيارات خلال فترات الدوام والانصراف. ضمان نظافة البوابة والمدخل الرئيسي للمركز بشكل مستمر. التأكد من أمن وسلامة الأطفال أثناء عمليات الاستلام والتسليم اليومية. تنفيذ مهام المشتريات الخاصة بالمركز ومتابعة أعمال الصيانة لضمان سير العمليات بسلاسة. التأكد من وجود بطاقات الأهل عند دخول وخروج الزوار والموظفين للحفاظ على النظام وحماية الممتلكات، ونشر اللوائح الداخلية للمنشأة. الاستجابة الفورية للإنذارات، والتحقيق في الحوادث، والتواصل مع إدارات مكافحة الحرائق أو الإسعاف أو الشرطة عند الضرورة، وإبلاغ الإدارة. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعتمدة في المركز. القيام بأي مهام إضافية يكلف بها من المسؤول المباشر. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال الأمن أو ما يعادله. القدرة على مراقبة الأماكن وحراسة الممتلكات بفعالية. القدرة على التعامل مع الأطفال والأهالي بمهنية. بيئة العمل يعمل حارس الأمن بدوام كامل في مركز الباندا لحضانة الأطفال بالدمام، المنطقة الشرقية، ضمن بيئة تركز على سلامة الأطفال وأمن المنشأة. معلومات إضافية هذه فرصة للانضمام إلى فريق ملتزم بتقديم بيئة آمنة وداعمة للأطفال وأسرهم. الراتب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

875fbb0b4e201d53.description: About the Role GE HealthCare is seeking a Clinical Education Specialist for Women's Health & X-Ray to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. 877e00196415eae7.description: نبذة عن الدور تعلن [اسم الشركة محجوب من قبل صاحب العمل] عن توفر وظيفة مدير مشروع بدوام كامل في مدينة الرياض. يتولى مدير المشروع مسؤولية قيادة المشاريع من مرحلة الفكرة 87d3ac0943664a5e.description: About Axios International Axios International is seeking a Health Educator to join their team in Riyadh. Collaborate with project teams to integrate HSE considerations into project schedules and workflows. Stay informed about local and international HSE regulations applicable to building construction and ensure strict adherence. Conduct thorough risk assessments for construction activities, identify potential hazards, and develop mitigation strategies. 8757e44d87f58b32.description: About Informa PLC and Tahaluf Informa PLC is a global events organizer. Tahaluf, a joint venture between Informa PLC, the Saudi Federation for Cybersecurity, Programming and Drones (SAFCSP), and the Events Investment Fund (EIF), operates as the largest B2B live and on-demand events organizer in Saudi Arabia. Tahaluf organizes large-scale events such as LEAP, Cityscape, Black Hat MEA, and CPHI Middle East. The Role of Social Media Manager The Social Media Manager leads the social media presence for Tahaluf through a combination of agency management and direct delivery. This contract role is based in Riyadh and focuses on managing external agencies and creators for social content production, while overseeing strategy, boosting, community engagement, and performance internally. The role involves growing and engaging audiences across platforms including LinkedIn, Instagram, X, Facebook, TikTok, Snapchat, and YouTube, with an emphasis on trends, creative direction, and measurable results. The Social Media Manager will collaborate with the Marketing Director, Head of Marketing, senior stakeholders, and external vendors to align social media efforts with overall marketing strategies and commercial objectives. Develop insight-led briefs with clear objectives, audience, tone, and success measures, and ensure creative output meets standards. Conduct quality control on all agency output, verifying brand voice, visual identity, accuracy, and platform suitability before content goes live. Regularly review agency performance against agreed KPIs and deliverables, manage scopes, escalate issues, and optimize retainer value. Identify opportunities to move work in-house and brief internal designers and videographers for urgent tasks. Set and implement social media campaigns aligned with marketing strategies and event milestones, such as launches, registration pushes, early-bird deadlines, and show days. Design and deliver targeted content across platforms to increase engagement, followers, and retention, including short-form video tailored for each platform's algorithm. Maintain brand voice in all posts and interactions, ensuring content purpose and relevance to the target audience. Produce and edit impactful, channel-appropriate copy with flawless proofreading in English; Arabic proficiency is an advantage. 87ddf2668fdc4751.description: At Salla, we are building the digital backbone of commerce in the region, empowering thousands of merchants to start, grow, and scale their businesses. We turn what's complex into something simple, powerful, and scalable. Catalog is the layer underneath everything. Storefronts, search, recommendations, landing pages, and every channel a merchant sells through all read from the same product data. When it is good, every surface above it gets better at once. When it is thin or wrong, nothing built on top can fix it. Two things make this exciting:. First, Salla does not build the catalog. Merchants do, and often not even the merchant: a freelancer, operations staff, an outsourced agency. Every surface we build inherits what those hands produce. So the question is not how to clean the data. It is how you change what someone produces when they do not work for you and mostly want to finish and move on. Second, no two categories need the same product record. What a fashion merchant needs is not what a pharmacy, a grocer, or a gold merchant needs. The easy answer is to build each category separately, and it does not scale. You will drive impact across five areas The Catalog Engine and Category Setup (one engine, built once, with what each category needs from a product record expressed as configuration rather than code, so supporting one more category is fast and repeatable) Product Data Input (creation, bulk import, editing, and everything that happens at the moment someone types or uploads) Structure and Meaning (taxonomy, attributes, variants, identifiers, normalization, and duplicates) AI Enrichment (extracting and generating product data from what merchants already have, with a clear position on confidence, review, and correction) Downstream Fitness (how this data actually performs where it is consumed: search results, storefronts, recommendations, and external channel feeds) Responsibilities: Own the catalog strategy end to end: sequence it into quarters, defend it in the room, and hold it accountable to the numbers it promised. Own the roadmap for how product data gets created and improved on Salla, prioritized on whether the data works downstream rather than on how many fields are filled. Design for the people who actually do the work, including the ones who do not own the store, and make the good path the fastest path rather than a longer one enforced by rules. Keep a new category, a configuration change rather than an engineering project, and be able to show the difference in effort between the first one and the next. Put AI to work where it earns trust: decide what we generate outright, what we suggest for approval, and what we never touch, with a stated confidence policy and a loop that learns from every correction a merchant makes. Define what catalog quality means at Salla and instrument it honestly, tied to the surfaces that consume the data rather than to completeness for its own sake. Own how product data performs in external selling channels, where the requirements are strict and the rejections are visible. Decide how much structure we impose and where merchants stay free, then defend that line against pressure from both directions. Lead 2 to 3 product managers: give them real ownership, coach their framing and craft, run a reliable cadence, and raise the quality bar of what the group ships. Work as one system with the teams that depend on this data: search and discovery, storefronts, vendors, marketplace, and data. Six or more years in product management, including work on a self-serve platform where users created their own content or data and you were accountable for the quality of what they produced. A number you owned and moved on that data: completeness that meant something, accuracy, time to publish, adoption of a data tool, or the performance of that data somewhere downstream. Evidence that you changed what users produced at the moment they produced it, rather than cleaning it up afterwards in a pipeline. We will ask which one it was. Platform judgment: you have built something once and made it serve many cases through configuration, and you can explain where you drew the line between what was shared and what was specific, and what that choice cost you. AI in production for structured data: extraction, classification, generation, or matching. You can talk concretely about confidence thresholds, error rates, what you let through automatically, and what you did when it was wrong at scale. Literacy in how product data is actually structured: taxonomies, attribute schemas, variants, identifiers, matching and deduplication, and the strict requirements external selling channels impose. You have coached product managers, formally or not, and you are ready to lead a small team without stepping away from the craft yourself. You own outcomes rather than roadmaps, you move quickly through ambiguity, and you build clarity where others see noise. You stay close to the details and you cannot guard your own area, because this data belongs to everyone downstream. Full professional fluency in Arabic and English is required. Merchant context in this region is preferred over theoretical knowledge. Willing to relocate to Saudi Arabia and work on-site.
